<svg width="1200" height="420" viewBox="0 0 1200 420" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>

    <filter id="softBlur" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">

    </filter>
